versions.changelog: Token验证修复：URL改为geo-api.yk-global.com/validate；新增本地缓存5分钟；优化tier推断

- 文档页底部新增付费购买渠道链接：[YK-Global.com](https://yk-global.com)
- 其余功能、界面和使用方式保持不变

Initial release with multi-format batch conversion.

- Supports batch file conversion between CSV, Excel, JSON, PDF, Markdown, DOCX, HTML, PNG, JPG, and TXT formats.
- Free plan includes all features for up to 10 files (permanent count, not daily).
- Multiple paid plans offer higher daily or unlimited file counts and AI-powered custom conversions.
- Integrated with Feishu: notifications and result files sent as Feishu cards/attachments.
- Robust error handling for encoding issues, unsupported formats, corrupted files, and account quota.
- Powered by pandas, PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, pandoc, python-docx, and Pillow for core conversions.
